parsed.english: For every dimension m, either the centered simplex has volume zero, or the integral of the position vector x over it is the zero vector. This is what barycenter = 0 means once the scalar factor 1/volume is unfolded.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the bespoke barycenter definition into a statement about the volume and the first-moment integral, and it makes the universal quantifier over n explicit.
